transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m here because I’m just… completely worn out. Even getting from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. And when I rest, it doesn’t really give me anything back.
Are you experiencing any pain?
Not really pain, no. I mean, my body feels heavy and worn out, but I wouldn’t call it pain.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yes. Most days I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling in my chest. Sometimes I’ll just end up sitting in the garage crying, and I don’t even know what set it off.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hopeless feeling?
About four months now. It started around when my wife went back to working full-time, and I was spending most weekdays by myself.
Do you find yourself enjoying activities or hobbies that you used to like before you started feeling this way?

No, not really. I used to look forward to choir, playing pickup basketball, working on cars, grilling for the family… things like that. Now I just can’t make myself care enough to go, or even answer people when they text me about it.
Have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or wishing you were dead?
Yeah… I have. I keep having this thought that I should just be dead. And when I’m by myself, it scares me, because I start thinking I might actually do something to make that happen.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear since you've been feeling this way?

Yeah… I have. Mostly when my wife’s at work and the house is real quiet. I hear voices, clear like someone’s standing out in the hallway, telling me I’m a burden… that my family would be better off without me.
Do you believe the voices you hear are real, or do you think they are just your own thoughts?

They don’t feel like just my own thoughts. When my wife’s at work and the house is quiet, I hear them clear, like somebody’s standing out in the hallway saying I’m a burden and my family would be better off without me. It feels real when it happens.
How often do you hear these voices?

It’s mostly when my wife is at work and the house gets quiet. Not every minute, but often enough that I’ve started to expect it when I’m alone. It sounds clear, like someone’s out in the hallway saying I’m a burden and they’d be better off without me.
Do the voices you hear stop when someone else is around?

Yeah… mostly, I think. It tends to happen when my wife’s at work and the house is quiet. When someone’s around, or there’s noise in the house, I don’t notice them the same way. It’s when I’m alone that they sound clear, like somebody out in the hallway.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt extremely happy, energetic, or irritable, and you didn't need much sleep?
I don’t think so. I can’t remember a time where I was really energized or happy like that and didn’t need sleep. If anything, I usually feel worn down.
Have you had times in your life where you felt completely back to normal between periods of feeling down or hopeless?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had better days than others, but I don’t know that I’d say I felt completely back to normal. It’s hard for me to tell.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high or euphoric?
No… I don’t think I’ve had anything like that. I’ve had moments where I felt a little better, but not extremely high or euphoric.
Have you had times in your life where you felt completely back to normal between periods of feeling down or hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d call it completely back to normal. There have been times that were a little better, but I don’t really remember feeling fully like myself between them.
Have you ever felt completely back to your normal self for an extended period between episodes of feeling down or hopeless?
I don’t really know. I’ve had stretches where things weren’t as bad, but I can’t say I felt completely back to my normal self for a long time. It’s hard for me to judge that.
Have you ever felt extremely high or irritable for several days in a row?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve been irritable at times, but not like extremely high or worked up for several days in a row.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely high or euphoric for several days or more?
No, I don’t think I’ve had that. I can’t remember feeling extremely high or euphoric for days at a time.
Have you ever felt extremely high or euphoric for several days or more in your life?
No, I really don’t think so. I know you asked that already, but I can’t recall any time where I felt unusually high or euphoric for several days.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt this heavy, hopeless feeling?
Yes. It’s happened more than once. I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling in my chest, and there are days I just end up sitting in the garage crying, not even really knowing what set it off.
Is this the first time you've felt this heavy, hopeless feeling?

No, it’s not the first time. This has happened before—waking up with that heavy, hopeless feeling in my chest. Some days I just end up sitting in the garage crying, and I don’t even really know what started it.
